notes.title: Re.Surs updated to version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Release version 1.0.2 Notes


 Fixed bug with the second battle in 'Lambda Lab'
 Fixed 'Out of bounds' bug for players in battle mode (while they used Basil's 'Tele-beacon' ability or somehow reached an unintended location)

notes.title: Re.Surs v.1.0.1 - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Re.Surs updated to the new version 1.0.1

 Fixed bugs with battle areas in ‘Lambda Lab’
 Fixed bug with triggers in ‘Saxara-City Pyramids’
 Attempt to fix rare bug with game locking after some events


Thanks, qsefthuopq for reporting!
